concept: Nine independent documentary subjects must not inherit unrelated research images merely because the old edits share a codec.

features.source: Owner science chronology, laboratory archive, documented research publications
structural_cut: Bought microscope from Qasr El Einy: date provenance separate from research
Real student laboratory and instrumentation training; photographs kept at correct chronology
Published experiments accompanied by their own original scientific figures
2017 diblock failure and 2025 zebrafish embedding failure shown as failures
Shift into doctoral ambitions through original rather than stock footage
deny: Every success inferred from an unaudited photo
Generic microscopy scene to describe unrelated method

features.source: 2021 Journal of Applied Physiology primary article plus 2020 Methods and Protocols chamber study
structural_cut: Separate cell models from in-vivo ventilation
Reconstruct true published chamber geometry
Use genuine original paper Figure 1 chamber
Study-specific original fluorescence and cytoskeleton figures
Dexamethasone and DHEA results with accurate comparisons and study limitations
deny: ventilator patient imagery falsely treated as this experiment

features.source: 10.3390/mps3040065 original chamber method and figure permissions CC BY
structural_cut: Flow geometry from source Figure 1
Advancing meniscus with exact source orientation
Real stills from Figure 1 study apparatus
Real viability/actin endpoints only if figure identity and controls confirmed
A single bubble in an epithelial monolayer is a model, not a diseased patient's airway

features.source: Owner 2025 failed agarose/paraffin embedding photographs and firsthand methods
structural_cut: Three actual original photographed specimen attempts
Two-percent agarose orientation setup
Subsequent paraffin embedding as separate phase
Actual sectioning failure and visible material separation
Possible methodological remedies distinguished from established cause

features.source: Owner photographs and sectioning failure; method hypotheses explicitly caveated
structural_cut: Specimen orientation
2% agarose layer and paraffin interface
Actual failed specimen photos not false micrographs
Sectioning mechanism annotated as hypothesis
What can be tested on next attempt

features.source: Owner early organic chemistry synthesis records, authentic compound routes, completed cyanide sensor publication as a separate project
structural_cut: The genuine proposed imidazopyridine route
Failed ring closure represented as failed path rather than product
Real authentic reagent/sample if exact notes verify
Later cyanide-sensing work shown distinctly, from 2019 paper, never claimed a successful ring closure
Uncertainty, interpretation, next hypothesis
deny: RSC cyanide figure presented as proof of successful failed route

features.source: 2017 owner's home microscope photographs and Qasr El Einy purchase story
structural_cut: Cairo Qasr El Einy as the stated point of purchase not unrelated mosque view
Actual instrument on desk and owner archive
Route from Cairo to Qatar with modern outlined map, clearly illustrative
Independent observation outside university schedule
No invented specific optical magnification or recorded specimen
deny: generic microscope image from commercial laboratory
false geographical location inferred from image

features.source: Source-labelled university and collaborator archives, dated original photographs and fellow researcher histories
structural_cut: Correct chronology and identity of group archives
Individuals named only with documentary permission
Acknowledge collaborators without inventing contributions
Original student-chapter footage only when event and date confirmed
Network of mentorship and laboratory continuity
deny: footage from different lab presented as original

Julāb medium: rose water, sugar and fruit differentiation
